posts.title: Alpaca Festival 2025 Performance Technical Overview
posts.description: For this first of hopefully many posts I ( Antonio ) wanted to do a technical overview of a recent live coding performance. On September 13th 2025 we performed at Sheffield’s Alpaca Festival which confusingly isn’t about alpacas and is actually a festival focused on patterns in music and art.
